question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

His (1)____ project featured modern technology, (2)____ processes and practical solutions, impressing the panel of (3)___ during the competition.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence highlights the characteristics of the project presented during the competition.
 
• The word "**innovative**" is appropriate for describing the project as modern and new.
 
• The processes used in the project are described as "**efficient**," meaning they are effective and practical.
 
• The panel judging the competition consists of "**judges**," which fits the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His innovative__ project featured modern technology, __efficient__ processes and practical solutions, impressing the panel of __judges__ during the competition.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Innovative (नवोन्मेषी)**: means introducing new ideas or methods.
 
• **Efficient (कुशल)**: means achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort.
 
• **Judges (न्यायाधीश)**: refers to individuals who evaluate and decide the outcome of a competition.
